description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. Weekly

• Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collections issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and

payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff

Accountant

graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their

technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income

statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End

Workbook, and Financial Package

Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience

Compensation & Benefits

  • USD 3,000–3,500 per month , based on experience

  • PTO after onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.


We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

WE ARE LOOKING FOR

All the necessary training to perform the necessary tasks will be offered.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The high-level goal for this role is to help the company to deliver accurate audit resolutions in a timely manner.


  • This role demands a high level of commitment and dedication; this is a full-time, hands-on position requiring 40 hours per week, with occasional after-hours work as needed (including additional compensation).

Be prepared for a fast-paced environment and to seek process improvements and personal development actively.


WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

  • Be detail-oriented. High level of thoroughness, accuracy, organization, and productivity;
  • Communicate fluently in English (advanced written skills);
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week during American business hoursç
  • Eager to learn and keen on coaching and feedback;
  • Open to failure and rejection in the spirit of learning, progress, and resilienceç
  • Ability to demonstrate a level of success in executing a repeatable operation methodologyç
  • Must be self-motivated, persistent, and able to work independently.


WHAT MAKES THIS JOB A GREAT OPPORTUNITY

  • Build subject-matter expertise in an area of real estate operations and insurance that is lucrative and is undergoing serious digital transformation;
  • Fair compensation with pay raises and bonuses;
  • Mentorship from talented leaders;
  • Be part of an award-winning company that is tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month;
  • Be part of a lean and agile team, with a strong culture;
  • Help Jones execute a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world;
  • Gain a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.



OUR CULTURE

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their roles and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward.


Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:


  • We get things done, period, full stop
  • We give help generously
  • We fall in love with customer problems
  • We feel the pain, then we fix the process
  • We build trust everywhere
  • We take care of ourselves with rest, time away from work and simply having fun



ABOUT JONES

Jones helps real estate and construction firms to remove the barrier of insurance compliance through one software application that integrates with core operating systems. We envision a world where every property and construction site is connected by a network of insurance data enabling individuals to find, check and verify compliance instantly. Over 1 billion square feet of real estate relies on Jones daily, including firms such as Empire State Realty, Tishman Speyer, JLL, Rudin Management, and many more.


We have headquarters in New York, NY, and Tel Aviv, Israel. Our team spans 16 countries. Brazil's crew is expanding fast, fully remote, with annual in-person gatherings.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the Job

What if every conversation you have, every partnership you build, could accelerate the progress of life science research and precision medicine?

At GeneMind, we are dedicated to making life readable and health actionable through independent innovation in high-throughput gene sequencing technology. We break global technological barriers, deliver accessible and reliable genomic tools to laboratories, hospitals, and research institutions worldwide, and empower scientists and clinicians to turn data into discovery—and discovery into real-world impact.

Working at GeneMind means joining a mission-driven team that combines cutting-edge R&D, industrial execution, and global growth. You will not only sell products but also shape the future of the genomics industry. Supported by passionate innovators, strong technical platforms, and a fast-growing global market, you will grow faster, achieve more, and build a meaningful career in one of the most promising fields of our time.


Position Summary

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Sales Specialist / Sales Manager will be the key commercial driver for GeneMind in assigned territories. You will build channel ecosystems, develop key accounts and KOL networks, drive market expansion, and deliver sustainable sales growth. This is a customer-centric, technical, and strategic sales role that combines channel management, key customer development, market insight, and cross-team collaboration—not just order execution. You will directly contribute to GeneMind’s global expansion and market leadership in next-generation sequencing (NGS).


Key Measures Of Success

  • Achievement of quarterly and annual sales targets, revenue, and order intake
  • Healthy channel partner development, activation, and retention
  • Successful development of key accounts and KOL relationship building
  • Accurate market intelligence collection and competitive strategy support
  • High customer satisfaction and long-term partnership loyalty
  • Effective product training and capability improvement for channel partners


Position Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage channel partners in assigned regions, expand market coverage, and build a stable, high-quality distribution system.
  • Identify and develop key customers and KOLs; establish long-term, trusted professional relationships.
  • Collect and analyze market dynamics, competitor activities, pricing, and customer needs to support regional sales strategies.
  • Deliver professional product presentations and online/offline training to channel partners to improve their sales and technical capabilities.
  • Support partners to close deals, including joint customer visits, demand analysis, solution design, and project follow-up.
  • Develop and execute quarterly and annual regional sales plans, ensure target delivery, and maintain healthy sales funnel management.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including technical support, marketing, and customer service to ensure smooth project delivery and excellent customer experience.
  • Represent GeneMind in academic and industry activities to enhance brand influence and market penetration.

The above responsibilities are representative but not exhaustive; duties may be adjusted to meet business needs.


Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Medicine, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or related fields ; Master’s degree is a strong plus.
  • Minimum 3 years of working experience in the NGS / sequencing industry .
  • Demonstrated experience in sales, channel development, or key account management in life science instruments, IVD, or sequencing-related fields.
  • Experience selling sequencing instruments or related laboratory equipment is highly preferred.
  • Professional, self-motivated, and target-oriented with strong learning and communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build trust with partners, KOLs, and research clients.
  • Ability and willingness to travel frequently as needed.
  • High integrity, customer-first mindset, and alignment with GeneMind’s mission and values.


Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in the life science or IVD industry.
  • Existing channel resources, customer network, or KOL connections in regional markets.
  • Experience in technical sales or solution-based sales (not just transactional).
  • Strong presentation, training, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Familiarity with NGS workflows, clinical diagnostics, or life science research scenarios.
  • Global market exposure or cross-cultural communication experience is a plus.


Who We Are

GeneMind is a leading global innovator and manufacturer of gene sequencing systems with independent core intellectual property. We develop and produce high-performance sequencing platforms to support scientific research and precision medicine across the globe. We embrace diversity, encourage growth, and empower every team member to create real impact.

We are an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:
A Immunomatics é uma startup sediada em San Diego, Califórnia, com a missão de melhorar os desfechos dos transplantes de órgãos por meio da seleção otimizada de doadores assistida por inteligência artificial (IA).


A empresa busca contratar profissionais brasileiros com conhecimento avançado em arquiteturas de deep learning.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, implementar, testar e validar modelos de IA para estratificação de risco.


O que buscamos

  • Pós-graduação em Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia ou Matemática.
  • Publicação de artigos científicos envolvendo o uso de redes neurais.
  • Experiência em projetar e implementar novas arquiteturas de redes neurais ou em personalizar arquiteturas existentes (CNN, RNN, Autoencoders, Transformers, etc.) para melhorar o desempenho preditivo do modelo.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de métodos e ferramentas computacionais.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Bônus: Experiência em Bioinformática.

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor

Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

title: SAP FI/CO (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP FI Specialist


Summary: Support and enhance Lubrizol Global SAP Procure to Pay (PTP) and Record to Report (RTR) process as a specialist,

with a primary focus on Procurement, Finance, Cost, Tax, and Localization solutions for Brazil and Mexico. Experience with CO.

Leverage deep knowledge of procurement and financial operations, tax calculation and compliance reporting within the Brazilian and Mexican legislative environments.

Engage with business stakeholders across the globe to ensure alignment and support across strategic priorities, technical domains, and standardized practices globally while ensuring that local and regional requirements are met.

Responsibilities:

Analyze, configure, test,deploy, and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions focused on PTP and RTR, especially as they relate to Procurement,

Finance, and Tax processes for Brazil and Mexico (including Nota Fiscal, CFDI, SPED, and related regulatory reporting).

Make recommendations for improving business processes and technology enablement, particularly around local tax compliance and statutory reporting.

Ensure accurate localization of SAP solutions to comply with Brazilian and Mexican legal and fiscal requirements, including tax calculation engines, e invoicing, and withholding tax management.

Develop standard business process design, configure, test, deploy and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions along with any bolt on for all procurement processes.

Effectively communicate and collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Business Partners, and Senior Leadership, as well as with other business stakeholders.

Resolve integration points between RTR, Procure to Pay (PTP), Order to Cash (OTC), and Treasury processes to ensure they are properly addressed.

Support daily operations for SAP Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes, including issue resolution, user support, and change management.

Makes decisions applicable to level of influence in the organization. Collaborate with cross functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

Utilize technical and functional expertise to support Procurement, Finance, and Tax initiatives.

Participate in or lead projects implementing or upgrading, tax localization, and compliance solutions.


Horario de trabalho: Comercial

Trabalho: Remoto

title: Gerente de Operações Financeiras (Financial Operations Manager)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Liaise with accounting firms for bookkeeping, document preparation, SPED filings, and tax submissions (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal audit and legal standards.
  • Collect and organize data for regulatory reporting to Receita Federal and the Central Bank of Brazil.
  • Monitor tax and foreign exchange compliance risks related to stablecoin-based transactions, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Handle foreign exchange filings and reports for cross-border crypto transactions (e.g., RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
  • Assist in interpreting local regulatory developments and aligning operational processes accordingly.
  • Provide financial and operational insights to support management in budgeting and strategic planning.
  • Support internal reporting, KPI tracking, and process documentation.
  • Effectively utilize financial operations software, crypto custody tools, and dashboards.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

  • Job type: Full Time


﻿Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, acompanhamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
  • Coordenar junto às empresas de contabilidade a escrituração, preparação de documentos, arquivos SPED e submissões fiscais (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com auditorias internas e padrões legais.
  • Coletar e organizar dados para relatórios regulatórios à Receita Federal e ao Banco Central do Brasil.
  • Monitorar riscos de conformidade fiscal e cambial relacionados a transações com stablecoins e escalar problemas conforme necessário.
  • Gerenciar registros cambiais e relatórios para transações transfronteiriças de criptomoedas (ex: RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
  • Auxiliar na interpretação de novas regulações locais e alinhar os processos operacionais de acordo.
  • Fornecer insights financeiros e operacionais para apoiar a gestão na elaboração de orçamentos e planejamento estratégico.
  • Apoiar relatórios internos, rastreamento de KPIs e documentação de processos.
  • Utilizar efetivamente softwares de operações financeiras, ferramentas de custódia de cripto e dashboards.

Requisitos:

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
  • Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
  • Familiaridade com relatórios financeiros brasileiros (SPED, Receita Federal, Banco Central) e conformidade fiscal (tax compliance).
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário e benefícios competitivos.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
  • A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora.NET - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend .NET - Pleno, para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Projetar e manter sistemas distribuídos baseados em microserviços.

Monitorar e diagnosticar aplicações usando ferramentas de observabilidade (ex: DataDog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch).

Utilizar bancos de dados não relacionais , como MongoDB ou DynamoDB.

Participar de pipelines de CI/CD , garantindo entregas contínuas e seguras.

Trabalhar com tecnologias de containerização e orquestração , como Docker e Kubernetes.

Utilizar serviços em nuvem (AWS, Azure, etc.) , incluindo funções serverless e mensageria.

Colaborar em projetos via Azure DevOps , utilizando boards, pipelines e repositórios.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiencia com .NET
  • EntityFramework
  • Injeção de Dependencia
  • DDD
  • Testes unitários
  • Experiencia com ferramentas de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Sqs, Sns, Kafka), preferencialmente RabbitMQ

  • Experiencia com docker e kubernetes;
  • Experiencia ou conhecimento do Azure DevOps


Soft Skills:

  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.

title: Software Architect (.NET)
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Information Technology Governance Consultant
description:
Remote

Long-term contractor - PJ

Salary - 25-30hr USD


Required Skills & Experience


• ITGC / SOX Readiness Lead

• SOX IT Controls Manager

• IT Risk & Controls Manager

• Senior IT Auditor who moved into readiness or Line 1.5 roles

• IPO or public-company SOX experience

• Personally designed IT General Controls (not just reviewed them)

• Executed management / interim testing before audits

• Owned SOX readiness end-to-end

• Partnered with IT, Engineering, and Finance

• Strong PCAOB and IPE fluency

ITGC Design & Testing: Access, change, IT ops controls; control narratives; management testing

SOX & PCAOB: COSO alignment, walkthroughs, remediation

IPE: Source systems, queries, completeness & accuracy validation

Modern Tech: SaaS, cloud, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD evidence


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


CISA strongly preferred

• CRISC, CISSP, CPA are a plus

• Experience outweighs certification


Job Description


A client of Insight Global is seeking a highly experienced ITGC & SOX Readiness Lead to serve as the central architect and owner of our IT General Controls (ITGC) program. This is a strategic GRC role designed for a hands-on leader who goes beyond checklist testing to partner deeply with Engineering, IT, and Finance to build scalable, defensible, and audit-ready controls.

This is not an Internal Audit role. Instead, you will operate as a “Line 1.5” enablement and readiness leader, responsible for ensuring controls are properly scoped, well-designed, automated where possible, and operating effectively before Internal and External Auditors begin formal validation.

You will own the full ITGC readiness lifecycle—from scoping and control design to interim self-testing, remediation, and audit coordination—ensuring predictable outcomes and eliminating last-minute surprises.
